item.description: Israel cerró el plazo para que los partidos presentaran sus candidaturas a las elecciones con 38 organizaciones inscritas. item.title: De la Espriella levanta la suspensión general al porte de armas en Colombia: ¿qué cambia y cuáles son los riesgos?
item.description: El presidente colombiano, Abelardo de la Espriella, puso fin a la suspensión general del porte de armas de fuego que se mantenía desde 2015, una decisión que devuelve eficacia a los permisos individuales vigentes, pero no supone una autorización para que cualquier ciudadano pueda comprar o llevar un arma. El Gobierno defiende la medida como un mecanismo de legítima defensa frente a la delincuencia, mientras sus críticos advierten de que una mayor presencia de armas entre civiles puede facilitar el desvío de armas legales hacia el mercado ilegal y debilitar el monopolio estatal de la fuerza… Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: 10,000 homes were demolished to build world’s heaviest building in Romania; the story behind it
item.description: Bucharest’s grand Palace of the Parliament, commissioned by dictator Nicolae Ceaușescu, looms large as a testament to an ambitious and controversial regime. The construction, initiated in 1984, involved the demolition of historic districts, displacing tens of thousands of citizens. Notably, it is the heaviest administrative building worldwide, although much of it remains unoccupied. The colossal structure's fate is precarious as it continues to sink slightly each year. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Albanian anger undiminished after 100 days of protests against Kushner project
item.description: Police in Albania blocked protesters from reaching parliament on Tuesday at the latest rally against a luxury development linked to US President Donald Trump’s son-in-law, Jared Kushner. Dubbed the ‘flamingo revolution’ for protesters’ signs depicting the pink bird that could be harmed by the coastal development, the protests are aimed at stopping the massive project that critics say would cause environmental damage and limit public access to the coast. item.title: US Rubio pledges to 'restore' ties with Colombia's new, Trump-friendly leader
item.description: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio on Tuesday pledged to "restore" ties with Bogota after four years of leftist rule, on day one of a three-nation tour aimed at bolstering conservative allies in Latin America. The trip to Colombia, Ecuador and Peru comes after a series of elections brought pro-US right-wing leaders to power, giving Washington an opening to tighten security and economic ties and push back against China's growing influence. FRANCE 24's International Affairs Editor Philip Turle tells us more. Fuente: France 24 - English.
